summary: Kootenai County summit lookout built from a 1913 crow's nest through 1963-64 towers; removed by 1979, with footings reported on the summit.

facts.design: Final structure was a 67-foot treated timber tower with an R-6 cab, built 1963 or 1964 after a 41-foot L-4 tower (1948)
facts.status_note: The final tower was removed by 1979. WillhiteWeb reports footings several feet off the parking area; the climbing guide reports no fire lookout on the summit.

visit.trail_note: Road and trail both reach the summit; WillhiteWeb says the last third of a mile needs 4WD and high clearance in summer, and most people park and walk the rest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com dates the 67-foot R-6 tower to 1964; Idaho Fire Lookouts and WillhiteWeb give 1963. The story reports both dates and the record keeps the 1963 event with the 1964 note.
Firelookout.com says eight miles southeast of Coeur d'Alene; the Idaho Climbing Guide says approximately nine miles. Both are reported.

notes_for_editor: History is well sourced: three independent sites agree on the tower sequence, with the 1963 versus 1964 date and the eight versus nine mile distance the only disagreements. Today's condition rests on two sources: the climbing guide (no lookout on the summit) and WillhiteWeb (footings, undated personal visit). Access is not stated as public or closed; the record's access stays unset. The 1928 Vedder entry and the 1972 entry come from the Idaho and firelookout.com staff lists respectively. The Stoesz 1949 strike is recorded as an event but is not a fire. The climbing guide also mentions a separate dilapidated cabin 100 yards away that the story says the guide does not link to the lookout.
